design_note: Append-only Aug. 26 current-overlay timeline. Occurrence dates are preserved where reported; publication date is not repurposed as event date.

records.summary: IRGC says Iran and Oman reached Hormuz control/revenue agreements; AP still describes the arrangement as evolving/potential, so final joint implementation remains unresolved.
Kpler preliminary data showed five commodity-vessel Hormuz transits Tuesday versus a 10-day average of 15; transponder-dark traffic remains a counting limitation.
Iran's 45-ship blacklist is affecting commercial vessel selection; Reuters sources said at least three Indian refiners and one global energy major planned to avoid listed ships.
QatarEnergy issued its first crude tender using ship-to-ship transfers outside Hormuz, extending Gulf commercial workarounds around the chokepoint.
